<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state after game over reset
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

# Separate into top and bottom rows
top_greens = [g for g in greens if min(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']) < 30]
bottom_greens = [g for g in greens if min(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']) >= 30]
print(f"Top row greens: {len(top_greens)}")
print(f"Bottom row greens: {len(bottom_greens)}")

# Sort by column
top_greens.sort(key=lambda g: min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']))
bottom_greens.sort(key=lambda g: min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']))

# Print positions
print(f"\nTop row positions:")
for g in top_greens:
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    print(f"  ({sum(rows)//len(rows)}, {sum(cols)//len(cols)})")

print(f"\nBottom row positions:")
for g in bottom_greens:
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    print(f"  ({sum(rows)//len(rows)}, {sum(cols)//len(cols)})")

# Try clicking only top-row green blocks first
print(f"\nClicking top-row green blocks one at a time...")
for i, g in enumerate(top_greens):
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}])
    
    greens_after = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"  Click {i+1}: ({center_row}, {center_col}) -> {len(greens_after)} greens, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("  GAME OVER!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("  LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
